clue.text: Some sheep, not fine, graze in 29's 6

indicators.note: 'not' tells you to leave out the letter for the word that follows it

parts.note: a fold is a flock, a body of sheep kept together
F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine
to graze the skin is to scratch it

explanation.surface: A farmer watches some sheep grazing, oddly in someone else's name.
explanation.walkthrough: 29 is NICK and 6 is NAME, so '29's 6' means another name for Old Nick, the Devil; several clues share that definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Old Scratch is a traditional nickname for the Devil, just as Old Nick is.

clue.text: Mercian monarch's American assassin caught?

indicators.note: to catch a remark is to hear it, so the word is taken as it is heard

parts.note: in US slang to off someone is to kill them, so a killer is an offer

explanation.surface: A history question: was an ancient English king murdered by an American hitman?
explanation.walkthrough: In a non-rhotic British accent OFFER and OFFA sound the same.
explanation.definitionFit: Offa was the eighth-century king of Mercia, the Anglo-Saxon kingdom that built Offa's Dyke.

clue.text: Draw last breath striking red regime changer?

parts.note: to draw your last breath is to die
Titian is a reddish-auburn colour named after the painter

explanation.surface: A revolutionary dies while fighting a communist regime it wants to topple.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Regime changer' looks political, but the regime is a diet: a dietitian changes what you eat.
explanation.definitionFit: A dietitian is a nutrition professional who prescribes and alters a patient's eating plan, or regimen.

clue.text: Something like 500 Enxet disembowelled younger son

parts.note: ca is circa, about or roughly
D is the Roman numeral for 500

indicators.note: removing the innards of a word leaves only its outermost letters

parts.note: first and last letters of the word

explanation.surface: Some 500 members of a South American tribe gut a junior son of the family.
explanation.walkthrough: The Enxet are an indigenous people of Paraguay, used here only for their outer letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Cadet historically means a younger son or a junior branch of a family, as opposed to the heir.

clue.text: Table talk about party on Republican right in state

indicators.note: 'about' places one word around the outside of the rest

parts.note: ana is a collection of someone's sayings or table talk

explanation.surface: Dinner conversation turns to a party allied with Republicans on the right of some state's politics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Table talk' is an old literary sense: a published collection of someone's sayings is an ana, as in Johnsoniana.
explanation.definitionFit: Andorra is a small sovereign country in the Pyrenees between France and Spain.

clue.text: Attention needed to carry through fine food

indicators.note: to carry something is to hold it inside, so one word goes within the other

parts.note: via means by way of, through

explanation.surface: Care is required to carry delicate food through a crowded room.
explanation.definitionFit: Caviare, an older spelling of caviar, is sturgeon roe, a luxury delicacy.

clue.text: Call individual lacking in love accepts in the morning

indicators.note: to accept is to take in, so one part goes inside
lacking means without, so a letter is dropped

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, an O

explanation.surface: A loveless person agrees to phone in the morning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Call' looks like a phone call, but here it is the verb meaning to give a name to.
explanation.definitionFit: To call someone something is to name them, so the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Sainted woman picks engagement rings up

indicators.note: in a down clue going up means reading from the bottom
to ring is to encircle, so the words surround the letters wanted

explanation.surface: A woman later canonised chooses some engagement rings.
explanation.definitionFit: St Agnes is a Roman virgin martyr, venerated as a saint.

clue.text: Grease gets stirred for seasonal specialities

indicators.note: stirring mixes things up, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A cooking instruction: fat is stirred in for some holiday treats.
explanation.definitionFit: Easter eggs are chocolate or decorated eggs made and given only at that festival time.

clue.text: Bubbly on ice with jet for discharge

indicators.note: bubbly suggests fizzing and churning, so the letters are tossed about

explanation.surface: Champagne on ice served on a private jet, ready for launch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bubbly' wants to be champagne, but it is the signal that the letters fizz around.
explanation.definitionFit: An ejection is a forcing out or emission, the same as a discharge.

clue.text: China doing away with resistance in 29's 6

indicators.note: to do away with something is to get rid of it, so a letter goes

parts.note: R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A country ending its resistance, put in a nickname.
explanation.walkthrough: China means a friend through Cockney rhyming slang, 'china plate' for mate.
explanation.definitionFit: The Fiend is an old name for the Devil, as Old Nick is.

clue.text: Jack in Devon say tortured in 29's 6

indicators.note: something tortured is twisted out of shape

parts.note: J is the abbreviation for jack in cards

explanation.surface: A sailor in Devon is said to have been tortured.
explanation.walkthrough: Jack looks like a sailor, apt beside the answer, but supplies just its J to the mix.
explanation.definitionFit: Davy Jones is the sailors' devil of the sea, whose locker is the seabed.

clue.text: Six Langley staffers surrounding rocky hill station

indicators.note: surrounding means placed all around another part

parts.note: the CIA has its headquarters at Langley, Virginia
a tor is a rocky hilltop, as on Dartmoor

explanation.surface: Six CIA agents surround a hill station, a British colonial mountain resort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hill station' reads as one phrase, but 'rocky hill' is the wordplay and the definition is just 'station'.
explanation.definitionFit: Victoria is one of London's main railway terminals.

clue.text: Hard to be expelled from immaculate social group

indicators.note: expelled means thrown out, so a letter leaves the word

parts.note: H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: It is tough to be thrown out of a spotless high-society circle.
explanation.definitionFit: A caste is a hereditary class or social stratum, as in the Indian system.

clue.text: Powerfully moved, with this Stubbs commenced to paint?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: pulled along by horsepower, the literal kind

definitions.text: with this Stubbs commenced to paint?
definitions.meaning: second meaning: the state of a horse once the painter has begun drawing it

explanation.walkthrough: George Stubbs was the great eighteenth-century painter of horses; once he began a picture its subject was literally drawn.
explanation.definitionFit: A carriage that is horse-drawn is pulled by horses, which supply the power that moves it.

clue.text: Old clan, Scots on holiday in Asian city?

parts.note: kin are one's family or clan
awa is the Scots form of away, as in away on holiday

explanation.surface: An old Scottish clan goes on holiday to a city in Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark covers that Okinawa is best known as an island and prefecture, though it is also a city.
explanation.definitionFit: Okinawa is a city on the Japanese island of the same name.

clue.text: Roused a hooligan keeping watch over corpse

indicators.note: to keep something is to hold it within

parts.note: a wake is a vigil kept beside a body before burial
ned is Scottish slang for a young hooligan

explanation.surface: A thug stays up guarding a body and is jolted alert.
explanation.walkthrough: Ned is Scottish slang for a young tearaway; the wake for a corpse sits neatly in a clue about being roused.
explanation.definitionFit: To be awakened is to be woken or stirred, the same as roused.

clue.text: Recluse finally in love ruined 29's 6

indicators.note: finally points to the end letter of the word before it
something ruined is wrecked, so its letters are knocked out of order

explanation.surface: A hermit at last falls in love, which brings ruin under a nickname.
explanation.definitionFit: The Evil One is a biblical epithet for the Devil.

clue.text: Standard round: rounds endlessly loaded into gun

indicators.note: loading something into a gun places it inside

parts.note: a round shape is an O

indicators.note: without an end means the final letter is cut

explanation.surface: Standard procedure: round after round of ammunition loaded into a gun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Standard' reads as normal procedure, but it is the definition: a flag or banner.
explanation.definitionFit: The oriflamme was the sacred red banner of the French kings, a standard carried into battle.

clue.text: Grassy surface devours one in Paris facing star

indicators.note: devouring something takes it inside

parts.note: sward is an expanse of short grass

explanation.surface: A lawn swallows someone in Paris who is facing a celebrity.
explanation.walkthrough: The star is the Sun, not a celebrity.
explanation.definitionFit: Sunward means directed toward the Sun, the star at the centre of our system.

clue.text: Elevated hero in Scotland knows 29's 6

indicators.note: in a down clue raising a word means reading it upwards

parts.note: El Cid is the Spanish epic hero

explanation.surface: A celebrated Scottish hero knows another nickname.
explanation.definitionFit: The dickens is a euphemism for the Devil, as in 'what the dickens'.

clue.text: Getting brown label to cover one among three 6s?

indicators.note: covering something wraps it, so it sits inside
among means within a group, so one item goes inside

parts.note: 6 is NAME, abbreviated N, three times

explanation.surface: A sticker covering one of three names, maybe on a sunbed.
explanation.walkthrough: 6 is NAME, and N is the dictionary abbreviation for name; I goes among NNN, and the result goes inside TAG after its A.
explanation.definitionFit: Tanning is the skin darkening from sun exposure, so the gerund matches the participle.

clue.text: Pet term abused in 29's 6

indicators.note: something abused is misused and mangled

explanation.surface: A term of endearment is misused within a nickname.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tempter is the Devil as the one who led Eve, and tested Christ, into temptation.

clue.text: Something worth 2 in 29's 6

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the two in a pack of cards or on a die
second meaning: another name for the Devil

explanation.walkthrough: 29 is NICK and 6 is NAME: Old Nick's other names.
explanation.definitionFit: A deuce is a playing card or die face of value two, and 'the deuce' is an old euphemism for the Devil.

clue.text: NHS must avoid badly crushing certain tongues

definitions.note: plural noun for an adjective used as a language-group name

indicators.note: done badly means put into disorder
avoiding something means doing without it, so those letters go

explanation.surface: The health service must avoid badly crushing patients' tongues.
explanation.walkthrough: Take N, H and S out of CRUSHING, leaving C, R, U, I, G, then rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Ugric is the branch of Finno-Ugric languages including Hungarian, Khanty and Mansi.

clue.text: Friends abroad stuffing cabbage — 12's Secret Item?

indicators.note: stuffing means packed inside something else

parts.note: cole is a cabbage, as in coleslaw

explanation.surface: Foreign friends stuffing cabbage, as a secret item at 12 Across.
explanation.walkthrough: 12 is VICTORIA, so the definition points to Victoria's Secret, the American lingerie brand.
explanation.definitionFit: A camisole is a woman's light sleeveless undergarment, the kind of lingerie Victoria's Secret sells.

clue.text: Ships at anchor carrying 29's 6

indicators.note: carrying means holding within, so the letters lie inside these words

explanation.surface: Anchored vessels carry a Devil's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Satan is the principal biblical name for the Devil.

clue.text: Deadly sin husband escapes in designated period

indicators.note: something that escapes gets out, so that letter goes

parts.note: sloth is one of the seven deadly sins
H is the standard abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: A lazy husband slips away during his allotted time.
explanation.definitionFit: A slot is an allotted time in a schedule, such as a time slot.

clue.text: Union matching deal

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a coming together in accord
second meaning: correspondence, as in grammar
third meaning: a settled arrangement or pact

explanation.walkthrough: Three separate definitions of the same word in three words.
explanation.definitionFit: Agreement can mean concord and harmony, grammatical correspondence, and a negotiated contract.

clue.text: Dravidian male feeding dog

indicators.note: feeding something puts it inside

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow or tail them

explanation.surface: A south Indian man feeds his dog.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dog' looks like the animal being fed but is the verb to follow.
explanation.definitionFit: Tamil is a Dravidian language and people of southern India and Sri Lanka.

clue.text: Cooler condition

definitions.meaning: second meaning: state, as in good shape

explanation.walkthrough: 'Cooler' looks like a comparative adjective, but it is slang for jail. 'In good nick' is British for in good condition.
explanation.definitionFit: Nick is British slang both for a prison or police station and for physical state or repair.

clue.text: Drawing together neat knots to secure chain

indicators.note: to secure something is to hold it fast inside
knots twist things up, so these letters are tangled

parts.note: a string is a chain or series

explanation.surface: Tidy knots are tied to hold a chain in place.
explanation.definitionFit: An astringent contracts body tissues, drawing them together, as a styptic does.
